injuries.name: Mark Williams
injuries.detail: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

missing_list.name: Luka Doncic
missing_list.detail: Doncic finished Wednesday's 123-112 win over the Bucks with 32 points (10-25 FG, 5-12 3Pt, 7-10 FT), five rebounds, five assists and three steals across 32 minutes. He exited to the locker room late in the fourth quarter due to an apparent right ankle injury and did not return, Thuc Nhi Nguyen of the Los Angeles Times reports.

missing_list.name: Austin Reaves
missing_list.detail: Head coach JJ Redick said that X-rays on Reaves' left heel came back negative, but they won't have another update until he undergoes further imaging back in Los Angeles on Thursday, Dave McMenamin of ESPN.com reports.

reasoning: On the season so far the Lakers are the stronger team; with home court the Lakers start about 4 points better, in a game of about 231 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Lakers win 61 times in 100, by about 4; most games like this end between 203 and 251 total points.
